text:
sophia: Quick sync — compatibility council action items for the v2 cutover. Want to confirm owners for the remaining infra blockers and a short rollout smoke plan. TL;DR: who owns 1) proxy shim failover, 2) telemetry tag consistency, 3) SDK rollback path?

ajay: I can take proxy shim failover. Plan: add a 5-min canary window, then automatic traffic shift. Will need eng-platform to enable the flag.

maria: I’ll own telemetry/tag consistency. Found two endpoints still emitting old tag `api.v1` in our request logs. Making a small transform in the ingress layer. Will open a PR today.

kevin: SDK rollback path — I can own a documented, testable rollback for Node/Python SDKs. Need a canary package and a `--compat-mode` env var. Will coordinate with devex for docs.

linda: FYI ops: our staging GPUs are at 85% because of the A/B tests. We should limit parallel canaries to avoid preempting upgrade tests. Suggest max 10% traffic slice.

ajay: @linda good call. I'll set the canary to 5% for the first 10 minutes then 25% for 30 min if no errors. That's in the rollout playbook snippet:```\ncanary:\n  initial: 0.05\n  ramp: [0.25]\n  verify_window: 600 # seconds\n```\n
sophia: Excellent. Maria — what's ETA for the transform PR? Any risk of missing traces?

maria: PR by EOD PDT. Low risk: adding a header mapping step in ingress. I did a smoke locally with synthetic traces. One caveat: older clients without header will show `unknown` region until they update. I'll add a fallback.

kevin: For SDK rollback, proposal: publish v2.0.0-canary, and add a quick revert script: `npx redwood-sdk revert --to v1.x`. I'll draft the script and tests.

ops-bot: [incident] staging-gpu-pressure triggered at 1769999200 — autoscale+1 triggered. Current GPU usage: 87%.

linda: Noted. Ops will add an extra ephemeral node for canaries, but let's keep the 5% window tight.

ajay: Another blocker: gateway-level timeout behavior changed between v1 and v2 for chunked streaming. Need eng-runtime to sign off; I saw a unit test discrepancy. @kevin any SDK impact?

kevin: SDK handles streaming but expects a trailing `done` event. If gateway now uses `end` instead, we need minor parser changes. I'll open an SDK PR to accept both.

sophia: Ownership checklist for the thread (quick):
- proxy shim failover: ajay
- telemetry tags: maria
- SDK rollback & parser: kevin
- canary ops & sizing: linda/ops
- rollout playbook: sophia (compile all items)

sophia: Action items — everyone pls add PR links and a 1-line test plan by EOD. I'll synthesize into the playbook and ping eng-release for the cutover window. Also: add a note about deprecation header `x-redwood-deprec` so clients can opt-in to verbose logs during migration.

kevin: Will add parser PR and test plan. Also will coordinate with devex to bump SDK package tagging.

maria: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingress/pull/812 — includes header mapping + fallback. Test plan in the PR description.

ajay: PR for canary config and proxy failover: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/1337 — includes rollout YAML and rollback hooks.

linda: Ops runbook updates will be in https://internal.redwood.dev/ops/runbooks/v2-cutover by EOD.

sophia: Great. Last check — are there any external customer dependencies (partners, enterprise contracts) that require notice before the cutover?

maria: A couple enterprise customers pinned to old behavior for telemetry. I'll send an advisory draft to support for customer comms.

kevin: Devex: please make sure the `--compat-mode` flag is clearly documented in the SDK changelog so customers know how to opt out temporarily.

sophia: Perfect. I'll compile everything into a concise checklist and post back here with a proposed canary window and cutover date options. Thanks all. :handshake:
